verdict.rationale: dLocal's own docs name the three pieces of this story in one-line mentions: "Automated onboarding, split payments, and settlements" and "Mass payouts," plus marketing copy about paying partners. That is a first-party claim of marketplace capability, but there is no API-level detail showing how it works. missing for 10: documented seller/sub-merchant onboarding API or KYC flow, split-payment request parameters or examples, per-seller payout mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
